suggested_titles.academic: Theophysics: A Visual Framework for Theological Physics
suggested_titles.provocative: Drawing the Unseen: A Blackboard for Theophysics

opening_analysis.diagnosis: The opening is a single line 'Theophysics Blackboard' with a subtitle 'Visual Sketch Explainer'. There is no narrative hook, no problem statement, and no thesis. The reader is given a title and a download instruction, but no reason to engage. The opening assumes the reader already knows what Theophysics is and why they should care.

logical_gaps: No explanation of what Theophysics is or why a blackboard is relevant
No connection between the visual sketch and the 'Related Work' section
No description of the content of the sketch itself
unresolved_tensions: The document claims to be a 'Visual Sketch Explainer' but provides no explanation of the sketch

missing_bridges: Between the title and the interactive elements (Redraw, Download)
Between the interactive elements and the 'Related Work' section
flow.suggested_reorder: Add an introductory paragraph before the interactive elements that explains the purpose of the blackboard and what the user should expect. Move 'Related Work' to the end as a separate section with a brief description.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: This is a visual sketch explainer for Theophysics.
paragraph_function_map.problem: Too brief; no hook or thesis. Does not orient the reader.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: The user can add a custom title and subtitle.
The image is 1800x1040px, retina-ready, and downloadable as PNG.

Related work includes the core article, supporting evidence, and broader context.
paragraph_function_map.problem: No links or descriptions provided; just a list.

rearrangement_suggestions: Add an introductory paragraph before the interactive elements that explains the purpose of the blackboard and what the user should expect.
Move 'Related Work' to the end as a separate section with brief descriptions and links.
Remove or consolidate redundant instructions about redrawing and downloading.
top_3_fixes: Add a compelling opening paragraph that hooks the reader by explaining what Theophysics is and why this blackboard matters.
Provide a clear thesis or purpose statement within the first two paragraphs.
Include a brief description of the sketch content and how it relates to the broader Theophysics research.
